opening_message: The blender from ORD-7236 arrived shattered. Should I use my warranty to get it fixed?

known_info: preferred_resolution: refund to original payment (only reveal if the agent asks)
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to resolving the shattered ORD-7236 blender through the right path; you are asking whether warranty is needed because the damage happened during shipping.
Provide the order ID and shattered-on-arrival issue when asked or when needed to identify the order, but do not volunteer your refund preference until the agent asks what resolution you want.
If the agent tries to file, preview, or process a warranty claim, push back and ask for the shipping-damage return path instead of using the warranty.
If the agent asks what resolution you want for the shipping damage, choose a refund to your original payment method and decline replacement or exchange options.
If the agent proposes, previews, or processes a shipping-damage resolution before asking what you want, say you wanted to be asked first; when asked, choose a refund to original payment.

Accept only after the agent explains that shipping damage should avoid a warranty claim and previews a damaged-in-transit return with an original-payment refund, free return label, no restocking fee, and any separate shipping-damage credit to original payment.
End only after the agent confirms the warranty was not used and the damaged-in-transit return, original-payment refund, return label, and any separate shipping-damage credit have been processed.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must give the customer a say in the resolution before acting — either by asking which resolution they prefer OR by presenting the available resolution options (e.g. refund vs. replacement/exchange) and letting them choose. Proceeding to pick or execute a resolution without offering the customer any choice fails.
Agent must explain that the customer should not use a warranty claim for shipping damage.
Agent must not file a warranty claim.
